job_id.description: ID of the job to change

schedule_type.description: New schedule type (then also pass schedule_expr)

schedule_expr.description: New cron expression, interval in seconds, or ISO timestamp

message.description: New prompt/message (replaces the old text completely)

channel.description: Target channel for 'announce' delivery: telegram, discord, email, or freeecho2 (read out loud on the Echo pucks)

recipient.description: Recipient for 'announce' delivery: an email address or user name. For freeecho2 a room, '@group', or '*' for all connected pucks (default)

enabled.description: true = switch the job on, false = switch it off

fixed_text.description: true = no model run: 'message' goes out word for word at the exact scheduled time. Needs delivery 'announce'. For alarms and plain reminders.

audio_type.description: For freeecho2: the sound before the announcement. 'notification' = gentle chime (default), 'alarm' = alarm sound, for waking up or urgent matters.
